Otak-Otak.note: Mackerel paste; egg; chilli paste contains belacan = crustaceans. Coconut milk is not dairy. Described as spicy.

Pie Tee.note: Wheat-flour cups; prawns; shredded egg. Sweet chilli sauce, mild.

Jiu Hu Char.note: Dried cuttlefish = molluscs, so not vegetarian despite being mostly vegetables; soy sauce = soy + wheat; sambal belacan served on the side = crustaceans. Mild.

Ngoh Hiang.note: Prawn; egg binder; beancurd skin = soy. Not spicy.

Kerabu Mangga.note: Dried shrimp and sambal belacan = crustaceans. Spicy.

Acar Awak.note: Sesame seeds; crushed peanuts. Vegan tag. Mild.

Ayam Pongteh.note: Taucu = soy; dark soy sauce = soy + wheat. Not spicy.

Babi Pongteh.note: Pork = not halal. Taucu and dark soy sauce = soy + wheat.

Kari Kapitan.note: Belacan = crustaceans. Coconut milk, not dairy. Spicy.

Chap Chye.note: Sounds vegetarian but cooked in dried prawn stock = crustaceans, not vegetarian. Beancurd skin and light soy sauce = soy + wheat. Glass noodles are mung bean (no wheat).

Sayur Lodeh.note: Tempeh = soy. Made without belacan or dried shrimp. Coconut milk not dairy. Mild.

Kangkung Belacan.note: Sambal belacan = crustaceans; not vegetarian. Spicy.

Tauhu Goreng.note: Tofu = soy; kicap manis (sweet soy sauce) = soy + wheat; peanut sauce. No shrimp paste, vegan. Mild.

Nyonya Laksa.note: Belacan and prawns = crustaceans; cockles = molluscs; fish balls = fish; tofu puffs = soy; egg. Rice noodles. Fish balls assumed fish + tapioca starch (no wheat) - judgement call, no case depends on laksa being gluten-free. Spicy.

Mee Siam.note: Dried shrimp; tofu; egg. Rice vermicelli, no wheat. Mild.

Nasi Lemak Nyonya.note: Sambal with belacan and anchovies; fried anchovies; peanuts; egg. Turmeric fried chicken, no batter stated. Coconut rice not dairy. Spicy.

Nasi Ulam.note: Sounds like a herb rice but has salted fish and dried shrimp. Not spicy.

Nasi Goreng Kunyit.note: Egg; light soy sauce = soy + wheat. Vegetarian, not vegan. Mild.

Prawn Mee.note: Yellow egg noodles = wheat + egg; prawns and prawn broth; pork = not halal. Chilli on the side, mild.

Cendol.note: Rice-flour jelly, red beans, coconut milk (not dairy), gula melaka. Vegan.

Pulut Inti.note: Glutinous rice has no gluten; coconut; gula melaka.

Kuih Lapis.note: Rice flour, tapioca, coconut milk; without egg.

Bubur Cha Cha.note: Sweet potato, yam, sago, coconut milk; no dairy.

Sago Gula Melaka.note: Evaporated milk = milk (this version is not the coconut-milk one), so vegetarian but not vegan.

Kopi O.note: Black coffee with sugar. (Local kopi beans are sometimes roasted with margarine; not stated, follows merchant's vegan tag.)

Barley Lime.note: Pearl barley = gluten (barley is a gluten cereal).
